import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)  # Source1_8_0 with columns ['track_id', 'dummy']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)  # Source1_8_1 with columns ['index_track', 'track_id']
    
    # Inspect schemas:
    # df0: track_id, dummy
    # df1: index_track, track_id
    
    # Transformation plan:
    # The target schema is ['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy'].
    # Source1_8_1 has index_track and track_id, but no dummy.
    # Source1_8_0 has track_id and dummy, but no index_track.
    #
    # We want to produce a table with index_track, track_id, dummy.
    #
    # The only common column between the two sources is track_id.
    # So we can join df1 and df0 on track_id to get index_track, track_id, dummy.
    #
    # This join will keep only track_ids present in both sources.
    #
    # After join, reorder columns to match target schema.
    
    # Perform inner join on 'track_id'
    df_merged = pd.merge(df1, df0, on='track_id', how='inner')
    
    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
    df_target = df_merged[['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy']]
    
    # Save the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {target_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
